(()=>{const g=__game, p=g.player.pos.clone(), t=g.boosts.tiles.find(t=>t.gift); const b=g.field.blocks.filter(b=>b.alive).sort((a,c)=>g.field.center(a,p.clone()).distanceTo(p)-g.field.center(c,p.clone()).distanceTo(p))[0]; const r=g.field.center(b,p.clone()); const dx=r.x-p.x, dz=r.z-p.z, L=Math.hypot(dx,dz); const k=((t.pos.x-p.x)*dx+(t.pos.z-p.z)*dz)/(L*L); const off=Math.abs((t.pos.x-p.x)*dz-(t.pos.z-p.z)*dx)/L; const sp={x:0,y:0,visible:false}; g.stage.toScreen(t.pos,sp); sessionStorage.setItem("gw", JSON.stringify({px:p.x,pz:p.z,rx:r.x,rz:r.z})); return JSON.stringify({case:"first can at the start, on the way to the first rock", id:t.id, playerToRock:+L.toFixed(1), alongWay:+k.toFixed(2), offLine:+off.toFixed(2), canToPlayer:+Math.hypot(t.pos.x-p.x,t.pos.z-p.z).toFixed(1), onScreen:sp.visible, secs:Math.round(t.left), gift:g.debug.state().gift, PASS:t.id===1002 && k>0.2 && k<0.8 && off<0.5 && sp.visible})})()

(async()=>{const g=__game, w=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("gw")); const dx=w.rx-w.px, dz=w.rz-w.pz, L=Math.hypot(dx,dz), nx=-dz/L, nz=dx/L; for(let i=1;i<=20;i++){const k=i/20*0.85; g.player.pos.set(w.px+dx*k+nx*1.5, 0, w.pz+dz*k+nz*1.5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));} return JSON.stringify({case:"walked past it 1.5 m to one side", buffs:g.debug.buffs(), giftTiles:g.boosts.tiles.filter(t=>t.gift).length, gift:g.debug.state().gift, nextIn:Math.round(g.boosts.giftAt-g.boosts.giftClock), toast:document.querySelector(".toast")?.textContent, PASS:g.debug.buffs().damage>0 && g.debug.state().gift===1})})()
